articles.text: SHÈYUÁN: Wèi! Bié zhāi bié zhāi! Zhè huār bù néng suíbiàn zhāi ye!
YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: Hey! Don't pick those! Don't pick those! Those flowers aren't for picking!
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Duìbuqǐ. Zhèixiē huār dōu shi nǐmen zhòngde ma?
AMERICAN STUDENT: I'm sorry. Did you plant these flowers?
SHÈYUÁN: Shì, yánzhe zhèitiáo gōnglù yìzhí dào dòngwùyuán, lùbiānrshangde huār dōu shi wǒmen zhòngde.
YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: Yes. We planted all the flowers along the side of the highway all the way to the zoo.
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Nǐ shi Rénmín Dàxuéde gōngren?
AMERICAN STUDENT: Are you a worker from the People's University?
SHÈYUÁN: Bú shì, wǒ shi Huángzhuāng Dàduìde shèyuán.
YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: No, I'm a commune member from Huángzhuāng Production Brigade.
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Nǐ jiālide rén dōu zài Huángzhuāng ma?
AMERICAN STUDENT: Is your whole family in Huángzhuāng?
SHÈYUÁN: Zài Huángzhuāng jiù yǒu wǒ fùmǔ gēn wǒ.
YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: In Huángzhuāng there are only my parents and myself.
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Nǐ yǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi ma?
AMERICAN STUDENT: Do you have brothers and sisters?
SHÈYUÁN: Yǒu, wǒ yǒu yíge gēge zài tiělùshang gōngzuò, shi huǒchē sījī. Yòu yǒu yíge gēge zài Shǒudū Gāngtiě Gōngsī gōngzuò, tīngshuō tāmen zhìzàode dōngxi yǒu bù shǎo hái chū guó ne!

YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: Yes, I have an older brother who works on the railroad. He's an engineer. And I have an older brother who works at the Capital Iron and Steel Company. I understand that a lot of the things they manufacture go abroad.
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Nǐmen dàduìde shēngchǎn jìnxíngde zěnmeyàng a?
AMERICAN STUDENT: How is your brigade's production going?
SHÈYUÁN: Wǒ tīng wǒ fùqin shuō, cóng chǎnliàngshang kàn, wǒmen dàduìde qíngkuàng bú cuò. Jīnnián wǒmen dàduìde zǒng shōurù děngyú Wénhuà Dà Gémìng shínián shōurùde yíbèi!

YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: My father says that from the point of view of yield, our brigade is doing well. This year the total income of the brigade is equal to one time the income over the ten years of the Cultural Revolution!
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Hé! Zhèi shi zhēnde?!
AMERICAN STUDENT: Wow! Is that true?!

SHÈYUÁN: Wǒ mā yě nàme shuō, Wénhuà Dà Gémìng nèi shíhou wǒ hái xiǎo, dàduìli fāshēngde shìr, wǒ dōu bù zěnme qīngchu. Wǒ jiù jìde nèi shíhou tiāntiān kāi huì, nǐ shuō dàrénmen máng ba, hǎoxiàng yě bù zěnme máng, fǎnzhèng shi kàn tāmen zǒngshi bú tài gāoxìng.

YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: My mother says the same thing. I was still young during the Cultural Revolution, and I don't know very well what went on in our brigade. I just remember that during that time there were meetings every day. But were the grown-ups really busy? Not really. In any case, they never looked very happy.
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Xiànzài nǐ jiāli rén dōu gāoxìng ba?
AMERICAN STUDENT: But now everybody in your family is happy, aren't they?
SHÈYUÁN: Gāoxìng, tèbié shi wǒ mā, yí dào Xīngqītiān jiù tuīshang yíbù xiǎo chē, shàng zìyóu shìchǎng le. Tā cháng gēn wǒ shuō, háishi zhèihuǐrde zhèngcè hǎo a!
YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: Yes. Especially my mother. Every Sunday she goes to the free market, pushing a little cart. She often says to me that the government's policy is much better now.
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Nǐ zìjǐ zěnmeyàng a? Yǒu shénme dǎsuàn meiyou a?
AMERICAN STUDENT: What about yourself? Do you have any plans?
SHÈYUÁN: Yǒu, wǒ fùqin zhòng huārde jìshu kě gāo la! Tā zhòngle yíbèizi huār. Tā gēn wǒ shuō zánmen zhèr shi fēngjǐngqū, zánmen bǎ huār zhònghǎole, néng gěi guójiā zhuàn wàihuì ya!

YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: Yes, my father is a real expert at growing flowers. He's been growing flowers all his life. He told me that this is a scenic area, and if we planted flowers, we could bring in a lot of foreign exchange for the state.
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Nǐ jīnnián shíjǐ le?
AMERICAN STUDENT: How old are you this year?

SHÈYUÁN: Shísì le. Wǒ fùqin hái zhǎolai yìběn shū, shi guānyú zhòng huārde, wǒ jīntian wàng zài jiāli le, xiàcì nǐ jīngguò zhèr wǒ ná gěi ni kàn. Wǒ fùqin shuō zhè shi kēxué zhòng huār, ràng wǒ hǎohāor xué.

YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: Fourteen. My father even got a book on flower growing. I left it at home today, but the next time you pass by here I'll show it to you. My father says that it's scientific flower growing and told me to study it hard.
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng shàng dàxué?
AMERICAN STUDENT: Do you want to go to college?
SHÈYUÁN: Xiǎng shàng! Hòunián wǒ jiù gāozhōng bìyè le, wǒ kǎo Nóngyè Dàxué, jiù xué zhòng huār.
YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: Yes! The year after next I graduate from high school and I'm going to take the exam for Agricultural University. I'm going to study flower growing.
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Hǎo! Zàijiàn!
AMERICAN STUDENT: Great! So long!
SHÈYUÁN: Zàijiàn! Bié jí, wǒ gěi ni zhāi liǎngduǒ huār.
YOUNG COMMUNE MEMBER: So long! Hold on, let me pick you a couple of flowers.
MĚIGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Xièxie ni.
AMERICAN STUDENT: Thanks.
